verdict.rationale: The only explicit bulk capability is in media: the image API supports batch generation of multiple images in one request, and image editing accepts up to five source images per request. Nothing shows bulk actions across many items in connected tools such as Salesforce, Drive or email, and nothing shows a general batch API for text requests. missing for 10: batch/bulk text-inference API, bulk operations across connector records or files (e.g., mass update or delete), documented limits for bulk jobs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
